custody: SELF (author-operated; ordinary non-admin Pro review tenant)
authority_policy_boundary: identity is independent of how authority is received; authority may be native or delegated, and when delegated the grant is evaluated from current state at the action boundary
evidence_scope: author-operated; independent reproduction not yet claimed; revocation latency not measured

reader_appraisal.trace_check: recompute SHA-256 of trace.jsonl and compare with manifest.public_trace.sha256
reader_appraisal.record_check: the underlying Proofable proof/receipt is a CAIP-380 envelope; verify it offline with verifyPortableProofEnvelope from the public Apache-2.0 @proofable/sdk
reader_appraisal.policy_digest: not emitted by the deployed system; authority_policy_version is the policy identifier

post_dispatch_revocation.separates: the next dispatch refusal (with its reason) from the earlier action's already-committed effect
